author: Google
description:
In honor of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Day, we collaborated with artist Kyndacee to create today’s #GoogleDoodle. Drawing from her personal memories of MLK Day parades, the painting pays tribute to Dr. King and his vision of community and collective action. 

“The piece depicts a young boy in his marching band uniform being helped by his father. We experience a moment of preparation before the collective energy of the Parade. 

“The dove and olive branch represent Dr. King’s vision of peace and nonviolence. The community groups, marching bands, and dance troupes capture the vibrant spirit that defines his vision of togetherness and unity.”

“Ready for the Parade” by Kyndacee
title: A tribute to Dr. King
